notes: ACCESS: hsn.com sits behind Akamai Bot Manager. Direct HTML fetches of /shop/ pages return 403 'Access Denied' on every desktop curl_cffi profile, while safari/firefox/iOS profiles return HTTP 200 carrying only a ~7KB Akamai sensor interstitial; r.jina.ai returned its own Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge; a 23-profile curl_cffi sweep produced exactly one full-content 200 (safari15_3) that proved non-reproducible. WORKING ROUTE (same as the prior Home-Decor pass): translate.goog - https://www-hsn-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=<lang>&_x_tr_hl=en - returns genuine server-rendered origin HTML. It 429s intermittently under the shared worker load; retrying with a rotated _x_tr_tl target language plus backoff cleared it every time. robots.txt was checked first: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive and no /shop/ disallow (the disallowed /search and /show-more-products/ endpoints were deliberately not used). Every `link` is a canonical www.hsn.com origin URL, never a proxy URL. TREE SOURCE: https://www.hsn.com/sitemap (the sitemap index) is served unprotected on a plain direct fetch and lists 14 department sitemaps. /sitemap/ho?name=home yielded all 366 Home nodes; the tree was then confirmed node by node from each listing page's own schema.org BreadcrumbList and its 'Departments' filter-group facet, which enumerates a node's children (or, on a terminal node, its sibling set). Home > Furniture (ho0115, 1384 items) has exactly 8 sub-departments, each with 3-9 terminal children; no level-4 furniture node exists in the sitemap or in any facet. QTY METHOD: every listing page carries data-total-products="N" on the product grid div (id=template-product-grid), duplicated as data-cnstrc-num-results (HSN runs Constructor.io). This is the rendered listing total and it was validated three independent ways: (1) it reproduced the prior Home-Decor pass exactly on unchanged categories (Mirrors 93, Wall Art 96); (2) each leaf's own page value equals the count HSN prints beside that node in its parent's Departments facet - true for all 46 leaves; (3) full pagination enumeration on the largest node, Coffee Tables & Accent Tables ho0190, shows five pager links of take=60/60/60/60/57 = 297, exactly matching data-total-products=297. SANITY CHECKS: counts vary per category from 1 to 297, so this is no site-wide constant; no suspiciously round values; every h1 and breadcrumb matched the node requested; a second forced re-read of Sofas, Coffee Tables, Desks and Barstools returned identical numbers (no intra-session drift). CROSS-LISTING: HSN files the same product under several nodes, so sibling counts overlap and do not sum to the parent (the 8 Furniture sub-departments sum to 1479 against the department's own 1384). Verified examples: all 13 Bathroom Stools are also in Barstools; 15 of the 22 Bedroom Benches are also in Living Room Ottomans & Benches. Each row therefore reports the site's own count for that node only - never a sum, never a parent's number. FURNITURE OUTSIDE THE HOME DEPARTMENT: the other 13 department sitemaps were slug-scanned for furniture terms. Real furniture nodes were found and included in Baby (Nursery & Kids Furniture b00013 with its Baby Cribs, Bassinets & Sleepers, Kids Furniture and Toddler Beds children), Kitchen & Food (Kitchen Islands & Carts qc0427) and Crafts & Sewing (Sewing Tables & Cabinets ct0281, Cabinets & Tables ct0160). Home > Bath also carries its own Bathroom Furniture listing (ho0471) separate from Home > Furniture > Bathroom Furniture (ho0138); both are kept and flagged. EXCLUDED, with reasons: Mattresses (ho0194, 59) and Cribs Mattresses (b00060, 23) - bedding per the brief. Slipcovers (ho0208, 2) - furniture covers. Patio Umbrellas & Outdoor Shades (ho0269, 41) - shade structures. The whole Home > Storage & Organization department (ho0299), including Shelving & Racks (ho0313, 124), Storage Carts (ho0549, 28) and Drawer Units (ho0551, 14): tiles were read and they are utility drying/shoe racks, rolling mesh office carts and folding storage chests - standalone storage goods reserved for the future Storage task, and not filed under any Furniture department. Kitchen Shelves & Storage Rack (qc0428, 16) excluded for the same reason. Baby > Feeding > High Chairs (b00004, 1) excluded - its single product is a strap-on 3-in-1 dining booster seat filed under Feeding, an accessory rather than furniture. Also excluded as non-furniture: Hampers, Nursery Decor, Baby/Kids Bedding, Steps & Ladders, Safes, Tool Storage, Pet Crates & Beds, Planters. Lighting, mirrors, rugs, wall decor and home accents were left to their own tasks.
